title: Parenting Boundaries
coreMove: Parenting boundaries work when the adult states the rule early, follows through the same way, and honors a child's age-fit no without handing over safety.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a screen-time rule can become a mood fight if the adult reacts from irritation
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the pause itself to restart a device charging rule before bedtime conflict peaks.

exampleSpecs.stakes: ordinary affection can teach either body choice or social pressure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Let a small observed moment show how a child can skip a hug and still greet a relative respectfully.

exampleSpecs.domain: extended family visit during a public event
exampleSpecs.stakes: a grandparent can undermine parent authority by treating household rules as optional
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Reconstruct after the fact how a grandparent bypassed the sleep routine and what evidence mattered.

exampleSpecs.audience: parents protecting attention during risky tasks
exampleSpecs.stakes: adult capacity needs a boundary without making a child responsible for adult feelings
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Catch the parent's own blame sentence mid-stream and repair it into a safety boundary.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a screen rule can vanish during transitions unless the adult writes the next step clearly
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Carry the scene through a written note that sets screen time, device charging, and bedtime follow-through.

exampleSpecs.audience: relatives and parents after youth sports
exampleSpecs.stakes: adult reactions teach whether a child's body no will be respected
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Give equal weight to a pressured hug and a respectful greeting choice at the sports field.
